sources.observed: Overhead slate roof, four-unit frontage bar, two principal paired rear wings, lower eastern extensions, separate garden courts and western/eastern access gaps. Roof displacement relative to ground must be accounted for.
Eastern front, three storeys, thin PVC frames, shallow brick segmental arches, projecting shop bays and recessed doors.
Western side brickwork, narrow gated gap, whole front receding eastward.
Eastern return white ground-floor paint, two small upper windows, stepped rear wing with blue doors and external stairs, single-storey service structures, Bijou blocked arched gable partly visible.

2026 auction publication: full frontage photo confirms four units 15–21 and eight upper window axes. Measured internal plan of 15 gives ground 74.0m2, first 65.7m2, second 54.5m2. Front internal width 4.8m; rear wing internal width 2.7m. Plans labelled approximate, not to scale.
Business identity and address 17 Anchor Street.
